messages:
alex: Quick question — I opened a PR that changes files under infra/deploy and CODEOWNERS lists @infra-team as owner, but the infra rotation is out this week. Who is allowed to approve/merge if no infra owner available?

priya: If the repo has 'Require review from Code Owners' enabled then GitHub blocks merge until an owner approves. Usually repo admins can merge, but that's frowned on. Is this a hotfix?

alex: Not a hotfix — small config tweak for staging autoscaling. Would prefer to avoid admin merge.

michael: Short-term options: 1) ping an individual on infra who has been active (they can approve), 2) request a CODEOWNERS exception via the eng-platform channel and an on-call approver, or 3) add a temporary fallback team in CODEOWNERS (requires a separate PR).

priya: To add to that — we have an internal pattern where eng-managers or the platform rotation can approve cross-team infra-ops changes when owners are OOO. See the runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/codeowners-exceptions (link).

alex: Thanks. What's the actual procedure for an exception? Do I need a manager sign-off?

samira: Procedure: 1) Post a short request in #eng-platform with the PR link and reason; 2) get explicit ack from an engineering manager or the impacted team lead; 3) an approver with write access (maintainer/admin) stamps the PR. We try to keep it lightweight for non-prod changes.

michael: Also note: if the change touches security-sensitive files we escalate to security and we don't bypass. For infra/deploy staging tweaks we can usually do the exception path.

alex: OK I'll ping @infra-team Slack alias and add the PR link here. If nobody responds in 4 hours I'll ask my manager for approval and flag it with the platform on-call.

jen: One more detail — GitHub branch protection records required reviewers. If you need to merge before owner approval, create a short PR describing the exception and add the label needs-owner-exception; eng-platform leads watch that label. :white_check_mark:

ci-bot: CI: build passed for alex/pr-4523 — all checks green.

priya: Thanks @alex. If you want I can try to reach out to one of the infra folks who is remote but might still approve. Otherwise follow the exception flow and please paste the manager ack in the PR comments.

alex: Awesome — tagging you on the PR now. Appreciate the quick guidance!
